X=Y=A=0.0
last=None
report=0
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,last,pts,report
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']
 v=o['motion']['v_mps']; s=math.radians(o['steer_deg'])
 if last is not None:
  da=v*math.tan(s)/2.5*dt
  X+=v*math.cos(A+da/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+da/2)*dt; A+=da
 last=t
 ca=math.cos(A); sa=math.sin(A)
 for view in o['views'].values():
  if not view: continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,d in view.get('walls',[]):
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   if x < -3:
    pts.append((t,X+ca*x-sa*y,Y+sa*x+ca*y))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[0]<7]
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=math.radians(o['hitch_deg'])
 gx=rx-3.5
 sides=[[],[]]
 for tt,px,py in pts:
  dx=px-X; dy=py-Y; x=ca*dx+sa*dy; y=-sa*dx+ca*dy
  if abs(x-gx)<2.3:
   baseline=ry+(rx-x)*math.tan(h)
   sides[0 if y>baseline else 1].append((x,y))
 target=None
 if all(len(q)>2 for q in sides):
  vals=[]
  for q in sides:
   mx=sum(p[0] for p in q)/len(q); my=sum(p[1] for p in q)/len(q)
   den=sum((p[0]-mx)**2 for p in q)
   slope=sum((p[0]-mx)*(p[1]-my) for p in q)/max(.1,den)
   vals.append(my+slope*(gx-mx))
  if 2.5<vals[0]-vals[1]<9: target=sum(vals)/2
 if target is None:
  steer=1.8*o['hitch_deg']; speed=-.35
 else:
  desired=math.atan2(target-ry,rx-gx)
  err=(desired-h)
  steer=math.degrees(.55*h-1.8*err)
  speed=-.55
 steer=max(-38,min(38,steer))
 if t-report>4:
  print('lane',round(t,1), None if target is None else round(target,2),'h',round(o['hitch_deg'],1),'steer',round(steer,1),'counts',[len(q) for q in sides]); report=t
 return steer,speed,64 if t%6<3 else -64

X=Y=A=0.0
want=18.0
lastprint=0
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,pts,want,lastprint
 dt=o['dt']; t=o['t']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']
 da=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5*dt
 X+=v*math.cos(A+da/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+da/2)*dt; A+=da
 ca=math.cos(A); sa=math.sin(A)
 for name,view in o['views'].items():
  if not view: continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,d in view.get('walls',[]):
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   if x<-2 and d<16: pts.append((t,X+ca*x-sa*y,Y+sa*x+ca*y))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[0]<10]
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; hd=o['hitch_deg']; h=math.radians(hd); ch=math.cos(h); sh=math.sin(h)
 sides=[[],[]]
 for tt,px,py in pts:
  dx=px-X; dy=py-Y; x=ca*dx+sa*dy-rx; y=-sa*dx+ca*dy-ry
  u=-x*ch+y*sh; z=x*sh+y*ch
  if -3<u<5 and abs(z)>0.8: sides[0 if z>0 else 1].append((u,z))
 vals=[]

  if len(side)<3: continue
  mx=sum(p[0] for p in side)/len(side); my=sum(p[1] for p in side)/len(side)
  den=sum((p[0]-mx)**2 for p in side)
  slope=sum((p[0]-mx)*(p[1]-my) for p in side)/max(.5,den)
  vals.append(my+slope*(2-mx))

  desired=max(-30,min(30,hd+math.degrees(math.atan2(sum(vals)/2,2))))

 if t-lastprint>3:
  print('clearances', [round(a,2) for a in vals], 'want',round(want,1),'h',round(hd,1)); lastprint=t
 return steer,-.25,64 if t%8<4 else -64

import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']; hr=math.radians(h)
    cam=obs.get('views',{}).get('camera')
    steer=1.9*h
    if cam:
        sides=[[],[]]
        for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
            r=math.radians(b); x=d*math.cos(r); y=d*math.sin(r)
            s=-x*math.cos(hr)+y*math.sin(hr)
            z=x*math.sin(hr)+y*math.cos(hr)
            if s>0.3 and abs(z)>1:
                sides[0 if z>0 else 1].append((s,z))
        def fit(p):
            n=len(p); sx=sum(x for x,y in p); sy=sum(y for x,y in p)
            den=sum(x*x for x,y in p)-sx*sx/n
            slope=(sum(x*y for x,y in p)-sx*sy/n)/max(0.3,den)
            return sy/n+slope*(5.5-sx/n)
        left=fit(sides[0]) if len(sides[0])>=2 else None
        right=fit(sides[1]) if len(sides[1])>=2 else None
        mid=None
        if left is not None and right is not None: mid=(left+right)/2
        elif left is not None: mid=left-4.2
        elif right is not None: mid=right+4.2
        if mid is not None:
            angle=math.degrees(math.atan2(mid,5.5))
            steer=1.9*h-2.4*angle
    return (max(-42,min(42,steer)),-0.65,-41)
